cases.translation: Your daughters in the field will be delivered to the sword.
cases.explain: The verb предаст (to deliver/hand over) takes the dative of the indirect object.

cases.translation: Will deliver your daughters on the field.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with a location uses the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Your daughters on the field will fall to the sword.
cases.explain: Дочерей is the direct object of the verb предаст.

cases.sentence: И поставит против тебя ___ и сделает вал.
cases.translation: And he will set siege walls against you and make a siege ramp.
cases.explain: Стены is the direct object of поставит.

cases.sentence: И поднимет против тебя ___ и сделает вал.
cases.translation: And he will raise his shield against you.
cases.explain: Щит is the direct object of поднимет.

cases.translation: Will deliver your daughters to the enemy in the field.
cases.explain: The verb предаст takes the dative of the indirect object.

cases.translation: Your daughters on the field will fall by the sword.
cases.explain: The instrumental case indicates the means or tool of action.

cases.translation: Will deliver to the sword daughters on the land.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with location uses the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Дочерей твоих на поле предаст мечу.
reading.question: What will happen to the daughters of Tyre?
options: They will be put to the sword in the field
They will be taken into slavery
They will escape to other lands
They will be protected by the city walls
reading.correct: They will be put to the sword in the field
reading.explain: The text states that the daughters will be delivered/handed over to the sword in the field.

reading.ru: И поставит против тебя стены и сделает вал против тебя и поднимет против тебя щит.
reading.question: What siege preparations will be made against Tyre?
options: Walls will be built, a ramp will be made, and a shield will be raised
Towers will be constructed and fire will be set
Ships will surround the city and supplies will be cut off
Tunnels will be dug and gates will be breached
reading.correct: Walls will be built, a ramp will be made, and a shield will be raised
reading.explain: The passage lists three siege tactics: building walls, making a siege ramp, and raising shields.

reading.ru: Предаст мечу дочерей твоих на поле.
reading.question: Where will Tyre's daughters meet their fate?
reading.explain: The text specifically places this event 'in the field' (на поле).

reading.ru: Дочерей твоих на поле предаст мечу и поставит против тебя стены.
reading.question: What dual fate befalls Tyre in this verse?
options: Her daughters are slain and siege walls are built against the city
Her wealth is plundered and fortifications are strengthened
Her people flee and enemies surround the harbor
Her leaders are captured and temples are destroyed
reading.correct: Her daughters are slain and siege walls are built against the city
reading.explain: The verse combines the slaughter of daughters with the construction of siege fortifications.

reading.ru: И поднимет против тебя щит и сделает вал против тебя.
reading.question: What does this military imagery suggest about the siege?
options: A complete and methodical military campaign with siege fortifications
reading.correct: A complete and methodical military campaign with siege fortifications
reading.explain: The raising of shields and construction of siege ramps indicate a formal, organized siege.

reading.ru: Поставит против тебя стены и сделает вал против тебя.
reading.question: What will be constructed by the attacking army?
reading.explain: The text specifies the construction of стены (walls) and вал (ramp).
